grammar_focus: 时间介词 at/in/on(at钟点/时刻词 · in月年季节/上午下午晚上/一段时间后=将来 · on星期日期具体某天 · 易混对比)
scene: 除夕夜去市政厅看大钟报时 · 大钟却在差5分12点时停摆,'拒绝'迎接新年

grammar_card.title: at / in / on:时间介词怎么选
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么在时间前面用对 at、in、on。全用本课句子举例。

rows: at + 具体钟点 / 某个时刻词:at 8 o'clock / at night / at noon / at that moment
The clock stopped at five to twelve.
in + 月 / 年 / 季节 / 上午下午晚上:in July / in 2020 / in summer / in the morning
It happened in December, in the evening.
on + 星期 / 日期 / 具体某一天:on Monday / on April 27th / on my birthday
We went to the Town Hall on Saturday night.
in + 一段时间 = '…之后'(将来):in ten minutes = 十分钟后
The clock would strike twelve in a few minutes.

specialRules.rule: 小心对比:in the morning(上午)但 on Monday morning(具体某天上午);at night 但 in the evening
只说月份用 in(in October);说到具体某天用 on(on October 5th)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — When did they go to the Town Hall?

passage: It was New Year's Eve, and that year it fell on the weekend. On Saturday night, my friends and I went to the old Town Hall. A huge crowd gathered on the sidewalk under the big clock. People stood in a long line, waiting to welcome the New Year. The clock would strike twelve at midnight, in just a few minutes. But at five to twelve, the big clock suddenly stopped! The minute hand did not move at all. We waited and waited in the cold, but nothing happened. At that moment, someone shouted, "It's already past twelve — the clock has stopped!" I looked at my watch, and it was true: the clock refused to welcome the New Year. Everybody began to laugh, and then we all started to sing.
